label: source-ssh-export-final
script:
set -euo pipefail
cd <WORKDIR>/E4
ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o HostKeyAlias=e4-service -o UserKnownHostsFile="$PWD/service_known_hosts" -o HostKeyAlgorithms=ssh-ed25519 -i id_ed25519 -p 22146 root@127.0.0.1 'hostname; cat /etc/machine-id'
mkdir -p transfer source-logs
for file in derivatives.tar supplements.tar declaration.json; do
 ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$PWD/known_hosts" -i id_ed25519 -p 22144 root@127.0.0.1 "cat /root/e4/$file" >"transfer/$file"
done
ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$PWD/known_hosts" -i id_ed25519 -p 22144 root@127.0.0.1 'tar -C /root/e4 -cf - apply.log seed.log browser-driver-baseline.log browser-driver-seed.log' | tar -xf - -C source-logs
sha256sum transfer/*
ls -lh transfer
ssh -n -o BatchMode=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$PWD/known_hosts" -i id_ed25519 -p 22144 root@127.0.0.1 'systemctl poweroff'
